description.narrative: BIRN Albania is a non-governmental media organization. This is an un-earmarked support to the Strategic Plan 2021-2025. Through high quality investigative reporting and a pool of skilled journalists, BIRN Albania examines and scrutinizes key processes, promotes debates and provides the public with impartial and reliable information. By making available data and public documents, BIRN will enable journalists and researchers to be in a better position to hold institutions and policymakers accountable in the progress made for the implementation of the commitments taken in the fight against organized crime and corruption. BIRN Albania will support journalists’ coverage from the regions, to bring the voice of the voiceless in the national debate and the public sphere, particularly for abuses linked with the environment and stories that provide a gender perspective. BIRN Albania will work with experts, donors and partners to strengthen its procedures in terms of gender mainstreaming, the integration of environment perspective, data protection and privacy.

BIRN Albania är en icke-statlig medieorganisation. Detta är ett icke öronmärkt stöd till den strategiska planen 2021–2025. Genom undersökande rapportering av hög kvalitet och en pool av skickliga journalister undersöker och granskar BIRN Albanien nyckelprocesser, främjar debatter och förser allmänheten med opartisk och tillförlitlig information. Genom att tillgängliggöra data och offentliga dokument kommer BIRN att göra det möjligt för journalister och forskare att vara i en bättre position för att hålla institutioner och beslutsfattare ansvariga för de framsteg som görs för att genomföra de åtaganden som gjorts i kampen mot organiserad brottslighet och korruption. BIRN Albania kommer att stödja journalisters bevakning från regionerna, för att föra fram de röstlösa i den nationella debatten och i det offentliga rummet, särskilt för övergrepp kopplade till miljön och berättelser som ger ett jämställdhetsperspektiv. BIRN Albania kommer att arbeta med experter, givare och partners för att stärka sina förfaranden när det gäller jämställdhetsintegrering, integrering av miljöperspektiv, dataskydd och integritet.

The objective of the intervention is that Albanian society upholds democratic values and freedoms allowing citizens equal opportunities to make informed choices and hold government accountable. The desired changes that BIRN Albania aims to achieve through its core programme during the period 2021 2025 are the following: 1) People have increased access to accurate information; 2) People have increased influence on democratic process: 3) People have increased opportunities to claim their rights; 4) Internal capacities of the organization are strengthened.

description.narrative:
During 2024, BIRN Albania has achieved important results under the 4 strategic objectives which are summarized below:
- BIRNs flagship platform, al, published 1,368 original articles, including 32 investigations and 310 in-depth analyses and features. The organizations journalism stood out in a crowded media landscape by actively scrutinizing decision-making processes, exposing high-level corruption, giving voice to underrepresented communities, and advancing critical public debates on topics such as judicial reform, electoral integrity, organized crime, gender-based violence, and environmental justice.
- BIRN maintained editorial independence and focused on public interest reporting. This differentiated role was further evidenced by the 12,060 full-text republications of its articles by other media outlets an indicator of both trust and reach. With over 5.5 million page views, 8.1 million social media impressions, and more than 795,000 video views, BIRN expanded its audience significantly, using accessible formats and digital narratives to reach new demographics.
- BIRN empowered local journalists and media outlets through 361 reporting grants and sustained editorial mentorship, supporting 42 journalists and training 60 more. Five strategic open calls targeted underreported themes such as healthcare, local governance, organized crime, and media freedom. These efforts broadened the scope of independent reporting across Albania and supported journalism outside of Tirana and the commercial media bubble.
- BIRN provides an important platform for civil society actors, independent experts, and grassroots activists, amplifying voices and perspectives that are frequently sidelined in Albania's concentrated media landscape. Stories published in 2024 gave visibility to causes related to gender rights, environmental justice, education reform, and digital privacy, among others, helping to shape more inclusive and pluralistic public discourse.
- BIRN's legal and investigative efforts yielded tangible results. In a landmark case, BIRN secured a Supreme Court victory that set a national precedent for transparency in judicial institutions. Its strategic use of Albania's Freedom of Information law including 85 FOI requests and over 685 documents published supported the largest open-access repository of public documents in the country, which continues to serve journalists, activists, and citizens alike. Meanwhile, data-driven investigations into public procurement, campaign finance, and the misuse of EU funds catalyzed official inquiries, parliamentary hearings, and widespread public debate.
- BIRN also led critical reporting on the justice system, publishing more than 400 articles and analyses on vetting outcomes, asset declarations, and disciplinary investigations of judges and prosecutors. These efforts provided citizens with unparalleled insights into the performance and integrity of Albania's justice reform a cornerstone of democratic transition.
- BIRN further positioned itself as a key advocate for media freedom and the protection of journalists. Through collaborative networks, research on disinformation and media concentration, and its continued watchdog role, BIRN defended the public's right to information and stood firm against pressures that seek to undermine journalistic independence.
